description: Defines revocation checking policies and functions for certificate validation, including constants for revocation age limits, RevocationPolicy struct, and revocation check functions.

classes.name: RevocationPolicy
classes.description: Struct defining revocation checking parameters and policies, with different definitions depending on platform.

methods.name: CheckValidatedChainRevocation
methods.description: Checks the revocation status of a certificate chain according to a specified policy, adding errors if any.

methods.name: CheckChainRevocationUsingCRLSet
methods.description: Checks the revocation status of a certificate chain using a CRLSet, returning the revocation result.
